Each chord $\overline{A_iA_{i+k}}$ is at distance $\cos(\pi k/24)$ from the center. For $k=9$ and $k=11$, the 24 chords in each family are tangent to a circle, with normals spaced $2\pi/24$ apart, so each family bounds a regular 24-gon with inradius $d_k = \cos(\pi k/24)$. The area ratio is therefore $(d_9/d_{11})^2 = (\sin(\pi/8)/\sin(\pi/24))^2 \approx 8.5958$, which matches Solution 3's exact simplification (I checked each algebra step).
